name: @starter/mcp
//bin: The binary name is an identifier, not a label: it is written into every user's host configuration file, so a rename orphans every configuration that already names it. It is a plain literal rather than a placeholder because this repository has to install and run before it has ever been scaffolded, and a brace in a bin key becomes a brace in a symlink name. `hatchkit` rewrites it, and src/identity.ts carries the same value. See cli/src/scaffold/identifiers.ts.
//scripts: A host package is outside the main build graph — nothing in the root `build` imports it — so a change that breaks it compiles green through the whole pipeline unless an aggregate script names it. `typecheck` and `lint` are reached by the root's `pnpm -r` scripts; `test` is NOT, because the root `test:unit` names its packages one by one. See this package's README.
